'''Donscarab''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Capobeetle]] at 18 stars, and into [[Beetleknight]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Donscarab's signature move is flicking opponents away with those reinforced front shells. Can't have Zobos blocking the light for the perfect pec flex."

Donscarab is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A buff, beetle-like creature that stands confidently with its hands on its hips and wears sunglasses. It is green with orange-yellow and dark cyan highlights and white wings pointed downwards.

Donscarab's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces dark cyan and orange-yellow with purple. It also becomes a lighter shade of green.

== Evolution Trial ==
Donscarab's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Beetleknight]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Shoot 60,000 pinballs.
* Feed Donscarab Bamboo Stew x15.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Donscarab insists it's all natural. No steroids. Just candy and protein powder. Maybe some Strega."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Donscarab trains every day and consumes large amounts of protein to maintain muscle definition. Often found admiring reflections by the water."
